information.title: Information
information.html:
Gibson Chu
(Close)

My photography explores the everday choreography of urban life, how people move and gather around the shared spaces in a city. I explore the relationship between people and their environment, in thoughtful ways that design, culture, and community shape the everyday experience. 

This results in series centered on people and organizations that intentionally care about candid interactions and human stories through both digital and 35mm film.

Outside of photography, I am a city planner and civic technologist, writing about the intersection of cities and innovation.

Available for commercial, editorial, event, and portrait photography.
Brooklyn, NY
